description:
Well I'll be, you are in a place we're calling a kitchen. The room seems oddly familiar, as though it were only superficially different from the other rooms in the building.

You make out a fridge. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? You scan the room for an oven, and you find an oven! You smell a wretched smell, and follow it to a table. On the table you can make out a cookbook. You see a counter. Make a note of this, you might have to put stuff on or in it later on. The counter is vast.
